title: 听力准备：改口与确认
goal: 先用文字识别最初提议、改口和确认，记准最终安排；正式听力练习待音频批准。

cases.transcript:
Mia: Shall we meet at the library at three?
Ben: I have a music lesson then. Could we meet at half past four instead?
Mia: That works for me. I'll wait by the library door.
cases.stem: What time will Mia and Ben meet?
evidence: Ben: I have a music lesson then. Could we meet at half past four instead?
Mia: That works for me. I'll wait by the library door.
reasons: three 是最初提议，后来被修改。
没有最终约定四点，half past four 是四点半。
cases.evidenceReason: half past four instead提出改约四点半，That works for me表示Mia接受；三点只是未采用的最初提议。

cases.transcript:
Leo: Are we making the poster in our classroom?
Nina: The classroom is being cleaned. Let's use the art room.
Leo: Good idea. I'll bring the paper there after lunch.
cases.stem: Where will they make the poster?
evidence: Nina: The classroom is being cleaned. Let's use the art room.
Leo: Good idea. I'll bring the paper there after lunch.
reasons: 教室正在打扫，不能把最初询问当作最终地点。
录音没有说去图书馆。
cases.evidenceReason: 教室在打扫，Nina改提美术教室；Leo接受，there承接新地点。不能把最初问句当作最终安排。

cases.transcript: Teacher: For tomorrow's walk, please wear comfortable shoes. The school will provide lunch, so you don't need to bring food. You must bring your own water bottle. We will fill it before we leave.
evidence: You must bring your own water bottle.
reasons: 午餐由学校提供，录音说不用自带食物。
录音没有要求学生带纸质地图。
cases.evidenceReason: must与your own限定学生自带水瓶；学校提供午餐，不等于所有物品都不用带。

cases.transcript:
Visitor: Does the number twelve bus go to the museum?
Student: It used to, but not now. Take the number twenty-one. The stop is just across the road.
Visitor: Twenty-one. Thank you.
cases.stem: Which bus should the visitor take now?
evidence: Student: It used to, but not now. Take the number twenty-one.
reasons: 12 路以前去，但现在不去；注意 used to 与 not now。
twenty-one 是二十一，不是 twenty。
cases.evidenceReason: used to与but not now排除现在乘12路，Take...twenty-one与复述确认现在乘21路；不是20。

cases.transcript:
Mum: Is your science club still on Tuesday?
Sam: It has moved to Thursday because our teacher has a meeting on Tuesdays.
Mum: All right. I'll pick you up after the club on Thursday.
cases.stem: On which day does the science club meet now?
reasons: Tuesday 是原来的时间，已经改动。
录音没有 Wednesday 这个安排。

cases.transcript:
Librarian: This book is due back on Friday.
Student: I'll be away then. May I return it on Monday?
Librarian: I'm afraid someone needs it this weekend. Could you bring it back on Thursday?
Student: Yes, I can do that.
cases.stem: When does the student agree to return the book?
cases.evidence: Could you bring it back on Thursday? ... Yes, I can do that.
reasons: Friday 是最初到期时间，不是最终同意的归还日。
Monday 是学生提出但未获同意的时间。

title: 听力准备：判断意图
goal: 先用文字分清背景、说话人、请求与回应，据原话判断意图；正式听力练习待音频批准。

cases.transcript:
Student: Excuse me, some of us are preparing for a talk at this table. Would you mind lowering your voice a little?
Friend: Oh, sorry. I didn't realise. We'll move to the other room.
cases.stem: Why does the student speak to the friend?
options: To invite the friend to give a talk
To ask where the other room is
evidence: Would you mind lowering your voice a little?
reasons: preparing for a talk 是提出请求的背景，不是邀请对方演讲。
学生没有询问房间位置。
cases.evidenceReason: preparing for a talk只是背景，Would you mind lowering your voice才是降低音量的请求，不是邀请对方演讲。

cases.transcript:
Mia: You weren't at the club meeting yesterday. Is everything all right?
Ben: Yes, but I wrote down the wrong time. Have I missed anything important?
Mia: We made a plan for Saturday. I'll send you the notes.
cases.stem: What does Ben want to know?
evidence: Ben: Yes, but I wrote down the wrong time. Have I missed anything important?
Mia: We made a plan for Saturday. I'll send you the notes.
reasons: 录音没有社团关闭的信息。
缺席的是 Ben，不是 Mia。
cases.evidenceReason: Ben问缺席期间是否错过重要内容，Mia用周六计划和愿意发笔记作回应；缺席者不是Mia，也没有社团关闭的信息。

cases.transcript:
Student: My model bridge fell down again. Maybe I should stop.
Teacher: Your first plan showed good ideas. Let's look at where it broke and change one part at a time. You don't need to start from nothing.
cases.stem: What is the teacher mainly doing?
options: Encouraging the student to improve the model
Asking the student to stop the project
Promising to build the whole model alone
evidence: Teacher: Your first plan showed good ideas.
Let's look at where it broke and change one part at a time.
reasons: 老师提出逐步修改，意思是继续改进，不是停止。
老师提出一起分析，没有承诺独自完成全部模型。
cases.evidenceReason: 老师先肯定原计划，再提出找断点、一次改一处；这是鼓励继续改进，不是让学生停下或承诺独自包办。

cases.transcript:
Nina: Let's take the path beside the river. It's shorter.
Leo: It is, but there was heavy rain last night. The ground may be slippery. I'd rather use the road through the village today.
Nina: You're right. A few extra minutes won't matter.
cases.stem: Why does Leo suggest the village road?
options: It may be safer after the rain
evidence: Leo: It is, but there was heavy rain last night. The ground may be slippery. I'd rather use the road through the village today.
Nina: You're right. A few extra minutes won't matter.
reasons: 更短的是河边小路，不是村里的道路。
录音没有购物计划。
cases.evidenceReason: 河边较短虽被承认，Leo却因昨夜大雨和可能湿滑提出今天走村中道路；Nina接受多用一点时间，不是购物或永远安全保证。

cases.transcript:
Teacher: Before you send the invitation, imagine you are receiving it. Would you know when and where to go?
Student: I've given the day, but I forgot the place. I'll add it now.
cases.stem: What does the teacher want the student to check?
options: Whether the invitation gives enough practical information
Whether the invitation has a beautiful picture
cases.evidence: Would you know when and where to go?
reasons: 老师关注时间地点，没要求图片漂亮。
邀请还未发出，不是在检查是否所有人已回复。

cases.transcript:
Ben: Mia speaks English better than anyone in our group. She should do the whole talk.
Nina: She could help us prepare, but we all need practice. Why don't we each explain one part?
Mia: I'd be happy with that.
options: Each group member should explain a part
Mia should give the entire talk
The group should cancel the talk
cases.evidence: Why don't we each explain one part?
reasons: 由 Mia 全讲是 Ben 的提议，Nina 提出了不同办法。
Nina 想分工练习，没有要取消演讲。
